literalGroups.primaryGround: L45-L46: food-conditioned wildlife can become dangerous; overly aggressive animals may be removed, including humanely killed.

literalGroups.primaryGround: L32,L43-L45: developed visitor areas expose wildlife to human food; unsecured trash and human food carry health/nourishment risks.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.fullPrompt: Какое правило помогает посетителям защищать диких животных в национальном парке?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.answer: Не кормить животных и убирать еду и мусор туда, где они не смогут их достать.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.note: Животные, привыкшие искать человеческую пищу, могут стать опасными; в крайних случаях администрация парка вынуждена их удалять.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.grammar: The infinitive-style rule is a complete natural response to “Какое правило помогает...?”; plural “животных” and coordinated “еду и мусор” are grammatical.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: Correct and uniquely supported: NPS says feeding intentionally or unintentionally and unsecured trash expose animals to human food (L42-L45). The note adds the concrete consequence that food-conditioned animals can become dangerous and may be removed (L45-L46), beyond prompt and key. Useful conservation explanation.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.locator: Full retained NPS page, https://www.nps.gov/subjects/watchingwildlife/animals.htm, lines 23-25, 42-46; relevant visitor/conservation claims at lines 42-46.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.fullPrompt: Какое правило помогает посетителям защищать диких животных в национальном парке?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.answer: Оставлять пищевые отходы у кромки стоянки, подальше от палаток.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.note: Оставленный мусор тоже становится доступной животным человеческой пищей и связан с плохим питанием и болезнями.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.grammar: Parallel infinitive action; “у кромки стоянки” and “подальше от палаток” form a grammatical visitor-rule answer.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: Plausible litter-management misconception, but incorrect: moving leftovers away from tents still leaves human food/trash accessible. NPS explicitly includes unsecured trash as a wildlife food risk (L43-L45). Note explains poor nourishment and disease risk from human food (L32,L43); useful correction.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.locator: Full retained NPS page, https://www.nps.gov/subjects/watchingwildlife/animals.htm, lines 23-25, 42-46; relevant visitor/conservation claims at lines 42-46.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.fullPrompt: Какое правило помогает посетителям защищать диких животных в национальном парке?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.answer: Подкармливать птиц и мелких животных только крошками.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.note: Даже крошки и объедки — человеческая пища; NPS связывает её с плохим питанием и более короткой жизнью животных.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.grammar: Parallel infinitive visitor action; “только крошками” is idiomatic and clear.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: Plausible but wrong “small amount is harmless” alternative. NPS explicitly mentions scraps and crumbs offered to birds and other wildlife and says human food has negative effects (L43-L44). The note adds poor nourishment and shorter lives, so it is truthful and useful (L43).
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.locator: Full retained NPS page, https://www.nps.gov/subjects/watchingwildlife/animals.htm, lines 23-25, 42-46; relevant visitor/conservation claims at lines 42-46.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.fullPrompt: Какое правило помогает посетителям защищать диких животных в национальном парке?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.answer: Кормить животных лишь пищей, подходящей их естественному рациону.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.note: Здоровый рацион дикие животные получают, охотясь, собирая или подбирая пищу естественным образом, а не привыкая к человеку.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.grammar: Parallel infinitive visitor action; “пищей, подходящей их естественному рациону” is grammatically linked to “кормить”.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: Plausible natural-food misconception, but NPS states wildlife achieves a healthy diet by hunting, foraging, or scavenging as it would naturally (L43); human-provided food can condition animals to seek people’s food (L45). Only option 0 follows this visitor rule. The note explains natural foraging and is useful.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.locator: Full retained NPS page, https://www.nps.gov/subjects/watchingwildlife/animals.htm, lines 23-25, 42-46; relevant visitor/conservation claims at lines 42-46.

correctNoteNewFact.fact: Food-conditioned animals can become dangerous; if they become too aggressive, park managers may remove them, including humanely killing them.
correctNoteNewFact.locator: Full retained NPS page, lines 45-46. This consequence is additional to the prompt and correct answer.
